description: A delightful black-and-white snapshot capturing a young boy named Michael wearing glasses, a white tank top, and dark shorts, standing barefoot on the sandy shoreline with his arms spread wide as an incoming ocean wave breaks. In the background to the right, a woman in a two-piece swimsuit wades into the surf near a seaside pier. The back contains charming handwritten notes documenting the scene at Asbury Park, New Jersey, in July 1950.
